question: The capacity of Vishakhapatnam, one of the oil refinery of Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Ltd, is:
solution:
The correct answer is __**8.3 million metric tonnes per annum**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The capacity of Vishakhapatnam, **one of the **oil refinery of Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Ltd,** is **8.3 million metric tonnes per annum.**
 
• Located on the **East Coast of India,** this refinery was established in **1957 by Caltex Oil Refining India Ltd.**
 
• HPCL (Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Limited) oversees operations at the Mumbai Refinery, boasting a capacity of 9.5 MMTPA.
 
• Moreover, HPCL proudly owns India's largest Lube Refinery, renowned for producing lube base oils meeting international standards, with an impressive capacity of 428 TMT.
 
• This Lube Refinery contributes over **40% to India's overall Lube Base Oil production**.
 
• HPCL further manages refineries in Mumbai and Visakhapatnam, with capacities of 9.5 MMTPA and 8.3 MMTPA, respectively.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Limited (HPCL) **is a prominent Indian **public sector entity **operating in the **petroleum and natural gas sector.**
 
• With its headquarters situated in Mumbai, HPCL functions as a subsidiary of the **Oil and Natural Gas Corporation (ONGC),** which falls under the purview of the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas, Government of India.
 
• Since 2018, the majority of HPCL's stake has been owned by the Oil and Natural Gas Corporation.
 
• HPCL has been recognized for its significant stature, ranking** 367th on the Fortune Global 500 list** of the world's largest corporations as of 2016.
 
• On 24 October 2019, it attained the status of a Maharatna Public Sector Undertaking (PSU).
 
• HPCL is dedicated to its mission of "Delivering Happiness," which it achieves through a commitment to safety, sustainable growth, and community welfare initiatives.
